notes: Reconstructed from all 93 discovered production import sites in the migration checkout; no baseline inventory was present. IDs are stable per owner file.

Sinks are the checker discovery tags. Type annotations have no runtime codec; their proofs exercise the shared ABI/form, display, network or wallet boundary used by the owning component. These are behavior proofs, not component-interaction coverage claims.

Connect is retained for wallet lifecycle and SIP-030; S014 includes loading persisted session data after remount and disconnect. Extended API/schema and metadata clients are retained by the checker default scope. BNS SDK is retained; its holding decoding is covered by S002.
No entries are dropped. The NFTTable proof covers the native wire input 0x02000000021234 and the Explorer ID, metadata key and both Gamma links.

Preserve merge-base IDs S044, X-EXP-1 and X-EXP-2. S044 retains the established address-validation behavior record alongside the reconstructed S043 owner grouping; X-EXP records keep explicit persistence proofs. No entries are dropped.
